slides.lineBottom: Playbook for Small Teams Who Ship Fast
slides.body: Be clear about what you automate, what stays manual, and why — because your workflow, and your whole team, will follow whatever example you set this quarter.

slides.quote: Great automations reduce the number of decisions a human has to make, not just the number of clicks it takes to publish something.
slides.subtext: Not just faster posting. Claude helps you plan, draft, review, and ship with judgment built into every step of the pipeline, end to end.

items: Keep a human in the loop for anything published
Automate only the genuinely repeatable part
Review every carousel before it goes live
Log what got posted and when, always
Version your templates so changes are traceable
slides.body: Don't chase full autopilot — automate the boring 80% and keep judgment exactly where it matters most for your brand.

slides.statement: Let Claude draft, plan, template, and organize your content calendar — but never let it decide what actually goes out under your name.
slides.subtextTop: Claude can help outline, design, resize, and schedule everything.
slides.subtextBottom: But the actual judgment call on what ships? That one's still yours.

slides.body: Small, consistent systems that you actually maintain beat one big flashy automation you abandon after two weeks.
slides.ctaSub: Save this post, screenshot the checklist, and come back weekly to check your progress
